Visibility and Tracking

Coğrafi Sınır

A virtual perimeter defined by GPS coordinates used in logistics to trigger alerts, monitor asset movement, or enforce location-based controls when shipments, vehicles, or containers enter or exit a designated area, as referenced in fleet management and security protocols.

Kisa cevap: A virtual perimeter defined by GPS coordinates used in logistics to trigger alerts, monitor asset movement, or enforce location-based controls when shipments, vehicles, or containers enter or exit a designated area, as referenced in fleet management and security protocols.

Kisa cevap

A virtual perimeter defined by GPS coordinates used in logistics to trigger alerts, monitor asset movement, or enforce location-based controls when shipments, vehicles, or containers enter or exit a designated area, as referenced in fleet management and security protocols.

Neden onemli

Coğrafi Sınır, Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, ve Customs Brokers icin Visibility and Tracking baglamlarinda daha net iletisim kurmaya yardimci oldugu icin onemlidir. Ayrica FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, ve IATA DGR gibi egitim ve sinav dilleriyle bag kurar.

Editoryal baglam

Coğrafi Sınır nedir?

Bu sozlukte Coğrafi Sınır su sekilde aciklanir: A virtual perimeter defined by GPS coordinates used in logistics to trigger alerts, monitor asset movement, or enforce location-based controls when shipments, vehicles, or containers enter or exit a designated area, as referenced in fleet management and security protocols.

Coğrafi Sınır lojistik alaninda nasil kullanilir?

Lojistik iletisiminde bu terim su baglamlarda kullanilir: "Dağıtım merkezi etrafında coğrafi sınır tanımlanır; giriş-çıkış yapan her kamyon, filo izleme sisteminde otomatik uyarı tetikler."

Coğrafi Sınır lojistik alaninda neden onemlidir?

Coğrafi Sınır, Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, ve Customs Brokers icin Visibility and Tracking baglamlarinda daha net iletisim kurmaya yardimci oldugu icin onemlidir. Ayrica FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, ve IATA DGR gibi egitim ve sinav dilleriyle bag kurar.

Coğrafi Sınır kimler tarafindan kullanilir?

Coğrafi Sınır agirlikli olarak Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, ve Customs Brokers tarafindan kullanilir.

Coğrafi Sınır hangi kategoriye aittir?

Bu sozlukte Coğrafi Sınır, Visibility and Tracking kategorisi altinda yer alir. Bu kategori yakin prosedurleri, komutlari ve operasyonel kavramlari bir araya getirir.

Bu tanim hangi kaynaga dayanir?

Bu tanim Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO kaynaklarina dayanir ve Protermify Logistics tarafindan statik lojistik referansi olarak yayinlanir.

Tanim

A virtual perimeter defined by GPS coordinates used in logistics to trigger alerts, monitor asset movement, or enforce location-based controls when shipments, vehicles, or containers enter or exit a designated area, as referenced in fleet management and security protocols.

Kullanim ornegi

A geo fence is set around the distribution center so that any truck entering or leaving triggers an automated alert in the fleet monitoring system.
